camera.description: Single fixed tripod camera in near-side/oblique view, full boy and both shoes visible, no camera movement; natural 35 mm photograph realism

track_provenance.orange: Apparent physical camera-near leg and same-side arm, retained across frames
track_provenance.teal: Apparent camera-far physical leg and same-side arm, retained across frames
track_provenance.warning: Which color is actual left foot has not been verified; do not equate screen-left with anatomical left

timing_note: Seventeen alternate contact states in a six-second illustrative form loop (eight same-track-leg returns): NOT a prescribed 5BX level cadence. App timing remains sourced from data/5bx-charts.json; do not use this video to count booklet left-foot touches unless physical left is independently confirmed.
rules: Use one immutable 13–14-year-old normal photographic identity, same clothes, face, environment, body scale, lighting and single fixed 35 mm camera
One real running-in-place body, not a slide show or forward-traveling runner; natural reciprocal arm swing, physically consistent ankle/hip chains
The same physical orange and teal legs alternate foot contact, with only low approximately four-inch foot clearance, NOT Chart 4 waist-high knees
Keep knees natural and feet athletic, no pointed ballet toes, no sudden leg-length changes, broken elbows or impossibly long occluded arm
Continuous real steps throughout 6 s, no fades, duplicate ghosts, teleported foot positions or camera moves; final physical stance returns to initial for looping
The booklet counts the anatomical left foot touching the ground; color markers from generated AI stills alone cannot establish which color is anatomical left
